action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [
        (logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'),
        (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'),
        (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call'),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D array")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric scalar")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    # Compute weights
    horizon = shape[1]
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weight = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weight.sum()
    weights = raw_weight / weight_sum

    # Weighted sums
    weighted_with = logp_with_result @ weights
    weighted_no = logp_no_call @ weights
    weighted_call = logp_call_only @ weights

    margin = weighted_with - weighted_no
    margin_call = weighted_with - weighted_call
    keep_mask = (margin > tau_filter) & (margin_call > 0)

    return keep_mask, margin
